  base=node:22-bookworm 380.0MB
  total_layers=5 image_size=963.0MB
=== multistage_builder (中间阶段，不进最终镜像) ===

  total_layers=5 image_size=963.0MB

code:
def mb(x):
    return round(x, 1)


SINGLE = {
    "base": ("node:22-bookworm", 380.0),
    "layers": [
        ("apt-get install build-essential python3 make g++", 320.0),
        ("COPY . .", 5.0),
        ("RUN npm install (with dev deps)", 240.0),
        ("RUN npm run build", 18.0),
    ],
}

MULTI_BUILDER = {
    "base": ("node:22-bookworm", 380.0),
    "layers": [
        ("apt-get install build-essential python3 make g++", 320.0),
        ("COPY . .", 5.0),
        ("RUN npm ci", 240.0),
        ("RUN npm run build", 18.0),
    ],
}

MULTI_RUNTIME = {
    "base": ("node:22-bookworm-slim", 75.0),
    "layers": [
        ("COPY --from=build /app/dist ./dist", 12.0),
        ("COPY --from=build /app/node_modules ./node_modules", 60.0),
        ("ENV NODE_ENV=production", 0.0),
        ("USER node", 0.0),
    ],
}


def image_size(spec):
    total = spec["base"][1]
    for _, size in spec["layers"]:
        total += size
    return total, len(spec["layers"]) + 1


for label, spec in (("single_stage", SINGLE), ("deps_only_no_build", None)):
    pass

s_total, s_layers = image_size(SINGLE)
b_total, b_layers = image_size(MULTI_BUILDER)
r_total, r_layers = image_size(MULTI_RUNTIME)

print("=== single_stage ===")
print("  base=%s %.1fMB" % SINGLE["base"])
print("  total_layers=%d image_size=%.1fMB" % (s_layers, s_total))
print("=== multistage_builder (中间阶段，不进最终镜像) ===")
print("  base=%s %.1fMB" % MULTI_BUILDER["base"])
print("  total_layers=%d image_size=%.1fMB" % (b_layers, b_total))
print("  builder_stage_discarded=%s" % (b_total == s_total))
print("=== multistage_runtime (最终镜像) ===")
print("  base=%s %.1fMB" % MULTI_RUNTIME["base"])
for instr, size in MULTI_RUNTIME["layers"]:
    print("  + %-50s %6.1fMB" % (instr, size))
print("  total_layers=%d image_size=%.1fMB" % (r_layers, r_total))
print("=== judgement ===")
print("saved_mb=%.1f" % mb(s_total - r_total))
print("size_reduction_pct=%.1f" % mb(100.0 * (s_total - r_total) / s_total))
print("final_layers=%d" % r_layers)
print("build_toolchain_in_final=%s" % any("build-essential" in i for i, _ in MULTI_RUNTIME["layers"]))
print("source_tree_in_final=%s" % any("COPY . ." in i for i, _ in MULTI_RUNTIME["layers"]))
